examples.en: The news of the school closing will sadden many students.
examples.zh: 學校即將關閉的消息會讓許多學生難過。

examples.en: It saddens me to see my old neighborhood change so much.
examples.zh: 看到我的老社區變了這麼多，我覺得很難過。

examples.en: Please do not sadden your grandmother by missing her birthday dinner.
examples.zh: 請不要錯過外婆的生日晚餐，免得讓她傷心。

examples.en: Several countries agreed to impose a sanction on the company.
examples.zh: 幾個國家同意對這家公司實施制裁。

examples.en: The club needs the principal's sanction before it can hold the event.
examples.zh: 這個社團要辦活動前，需要校長的許可。

examples.en: A trade sanction can hurt ordinary people as well as governments.
examples.zh: 貿易制裁可能傷害一般人民，也會傷害政府。

examples.en: The school will not sanction students leaving class early.
examples.zh: 學校不准許學生提早離開教室。

examples.en: The committee voted to sanction the new travel plan.
examples.zh: 委員會投票批准了新的旅遊計畫。

examples.en: Our manager refused to sanction the extra spending on decorations.
examples.zh: 我們經理拒絕批准額外的裝飾費用。

examples.en: There is an old saying that practice makes perfect.
examples.zh: 有句古老的諺語說熟能生巧。

examples.en: My grandfather has a saying for every situation.
examples.zh: 我爺爺對每種情況都有一句俗話。

examples.en: The saying "better late than never" is very common in English.
examples.zh: 「遲到總比不到好」這句話在英文裡很常見。

examples.en: I bumped into an old schoolmate at the train station.
examples.zh: 我在火車站巧遇一位老同學。

examples.en: My schoolmate lent me her notes after I was sick.
examples.zh: 我生病後，同學把筆記借給我。

examples.en: He still keeps in touch with a few schoolmates from junior high.
examples.zh: 他仍和幾位國中同學保持聯絡。

examples.en: We spent the weekend at the seaside with our cousins.
examples.zh: 我們和表兄弟姊妹在海邊度過週末。

examples.en: The hotel is located right by the seaside.
examples.zh: 這間旅館就位在海邊。

examples.en: Many tourists visit the seaside town in summer.
examples.zh: 許多遊客在夏天造訪這個海濱小鎮。

examples.en: She bought a second-hand bicycle for only fifty dollars.
examples.zh: 她只花五十元買了一輛二手腳踏車。

examples.en: This shop sells second-hand books at low prices.
examples.zh: 這家店以低價販售二手書。

examples.en: I only heard the story second-hand, so I am not sure it is true.
examples.zh: 我只是聽別人轉述這件事，所以不確定是否屬實。

examples.en: He bought the camera second-hand from a friend.
examples.zh: 他向朋友買了這台二手相機。

examples.en: I learned about the plan second-hand through my classmate.
examples.zh: 我是透過同學間接得知這項計畫的。

examples.en: They usually buy furniture second-hand to save money.
examples.zh: 他們通常買二手家具來省錢。

examples.en: The two companies reached a settlement after months of talks.
examples.zh: 兩家公司經過數月談判後達成和解。

examples.en: Early settlements grew up along the river.
examples.zh: 早期的定居地沿著河流發展起來。

examples.en: Please wait for the final settlement of your bill.
examples.zh: 請等候您帳單的最後結算。

examples.en: The setup of the new printer took only ten minutes.
examples.zh: 新印表機的設置只花了十分鐘。

examples.en: Her desk setup includes two screens and a small lamp.
examples.zh: 她的書桌配置包括兩個螢幕和一盞小檯燈。

examples.en: The setup for tomorrow's meeting is already finished.
examples.zh: 明天會議的場地安排已經完成了。

examples.en: The shining stars made the night sky beautiful.
examples.zh: 閃亮的星星讓夜空變得很美。

examples.en: She gave us a shining example of hard work.
examples.zh: 她為我們樹立了努力工作的傑出榜樣。

examples.en: The children ran toward the shining lake.
examples.zh: 孩子們跑向波光粼粼的湖。

examples.en: My brother is short-sighted and wears glasses all day.
examples.zh: 我弟弟近視，整天都戴眼鏡。

examples.en: It would be short-sighted to ignore the cost of repairs.
examples.zh: 忽視維修費用是很短視的。

examples.en: The manager made a short-sighted decision about the budget.
examples.zh: 經理對預算做了一個短視的決定。

examples.en: This short-term loan must be paid back within a month.
examples.zh: 這筆短期貸款必須在一個月內還清。

examples.en: She found a short-term job during the summer vacation.
examples.zh: 她在暑假找到一份短期工作。

examples.en: The short-term effects of the medicine are mild.
examples.zh: 這種藥的短期效果很溫和。

examples.en: We took a shortcut through the park to get to school.
examples.zh: 我們穿過公園走捷徑去學校。

examples.en: There is no shortcut to learning a new language.
examples.zh: 學習一種新語言沒有捷徑。

examples.en: Press this keyboard shortcut to save your file quickly.
examples.zh: 按這個鍵盤快捷鍵就能快速存檔。

examples.en: Her sickness kept her at home for a whole week.
examples.zh: 她的病讓她在家待了一整個星期。

examples.en: Many people get motion sickness on long bus rides.
examples.zh: 許多人搭長途公車時會暈車。

examples.en: Regular exercise can help prevent sickness.
examples.zh: 規律運動有助於預防疾病。

examples.en: The kitchen was smoky after the toast burned.
examples.zh: 吐司烤焦後，廚房煙霧瀰漫。

examples.en: I like the smoky flavor of this grilled fish.
examples.zh: 我喜歡這條烤魚的煙燻味。

examples.en: We left the smoky room and opened a window.
examples.zh: 我們離開煙霧瀰漫的房間，並打開窗戶。

examples.en: The town lies in the south-east of the country.
examples.zh: 這個小鎮位於該國的東南部。

examples.en: Clouds are moving in from the south-east.
examples.zh: 雲層正從東南方飄來。

examples.en: Our hotel is in the south-east of the city.
examples.zh: 我們的旅館位於市區東南部。

examples.en: The south-east coast is famous for its beaches.
examples.zh: 東南海岸以海灘聞名。

examples.en: A south-east wind brought warm rain.
examples.zh: 東南風帶來了溫暖的雨。

examples.en: We took the south-east exit from the highway.
examples.zh: 我們從高速公路的東南出口下去。

examples.en: Rain is expected in the south-west tonight.
examples.zh: 預計今晚西南部會下雨。

examples.en: The farm is in the south-west of the island.
examples.zh: 這座農場位於島的西南部。

examples.en: Birds fly to the south-west in autumn.
examples.zh: 秋天時，鳥兒飛往西南方。

examples.en: The south-west corner of the room is very bright.
examples.zh: 房間的西南角非常明亮。

examples.en: A south-west wind cooled the afternoon air.
examples.zh: 西南風使午後的空氣變涼爽。

examples.en: They live in a small south-west town near the sea.
examples.zh: 他們住在靠海的西南部小鎮。

examples.en: This hospital has a specialized unit for children.
examples.zh: 這家醫院有專門的兒童病房。

examples.en: He needs specialized training to repair these machines.
examples.zh: 他需要專門的訓練才能修理這些機器。

examples.en: The store sells specialized tools for bakers.
examples.zh: 這家店販售烘焙師專用的工具。

examples.en: My cousin is a talented sportsperson who trains every day.
examples.zh: 我表哥是個有天分的運動員，每天都訓練。

examples.en: A good sportsperson respects the rules and the other players.
examples.zh: 好的運動員會尊重規則和其他選手。

examples.en: The school invited a famous sportsperson to give a talk.
examples.zh: 學校邀請了一位知名運動員來演講。

examples.en: The old house has a wide wooden staircase.
examples.zh: 這棟老房子有一座寬敞的木製樓梯。

examples.en: Please do not leave bags on the staircase.
examples.zh: 請不要把袋子放在樓梯上。

examples.en: Our classroom is at the top of the staircase.
examples.zh: 我們的教室就在樓梯頂端。

examples.en: The company released a statement about the delay.
examples.zh: 公司發表了一份關於延誤的聲明。

examples.en: Please check your bank statement every month.
examples.zh: 請每個月核對您的銀行對帳單。

examples.en: The witness changed her statement after thinking again.
examples.zh: 證人重新考慮後更改了她的陳述。

examples.en: Their apartment building has twelve storeys.
examples.zh: 他們的公寓大樓有十二層樓。

examples.en: We live on the third storey of this building.
examples.zh: 我們住在這棟大樓的三樓。

examples.en: The library has only one storey and stands near the park.
examples.zh: 這間圖書館只有一層樓，位於公園附近。

senses.zh: 說故事的人；講故事的人

examples.en: The storyteller made the children laugh at the library.
examples.zh: 說故事的人在圖書館逗得孩子們哈哈大笑。

examples.en: My grandmother is a wonderful storyteller.
examples.zh: 我外婆是個很會說故事的人。

examples.en: The festival invited a storyteller from another country.
examples.zh: 這個慶典邀請了一位來自外國的說書人。

examples.en: The doctor wanted to reduce the patient's suffering.
examples.zh: 醫生想減輕病人的痛苦。

examples.en: Donations can help ease the suffering of people after floods.
examples.zh: 捐款可以幫助減輕水災後人們的苦難。

examples.en: There was a lot of suffering during the long drought.
examples.zh: 漫長的乾旱期間有許多苦難。

examples.en: Tourists like to sunbathe on the beach in summer.
examples.zh: 遊客夏天喜歡在海灘做日光浴。

examples.en: You should not sunbathe for too long without sunscreen.
examples.zh: 沒擦防曬乳就不該曬太久的太陽。

examples.en: We sunbathed by the pool all afternoon.
examples.zh: 我們整個下午都在泳池邊做日光浴。

examples.en: Sunlight came through the window and warmed the room.
examples.zh: 陽光從窗戶照進來，讓房間變暖和。

examples.en: Plants need sunlight and water to grow.
examples.zh: 植物需要陽光和水才能生長。

examples.en: Too much sunlight can hurt your skin.
examples.zh: 曬太多陽光會傷害皮膚。

examples.en: We woke up early to watch the sunrise.
examples.zh: 我們一大早起床看日出。

examples.en: The farmers start work at sunrise.
examples.zh: 農夫們在日出時開始工作。

examples.en: The sky turned pink just before sunrise.
examples.zh: 日出前，天空變成粉紅色。

examples.en: The sunset over the sea was beautiful.
examples.zh: 海上的夕陽很美。

examples.en: We had dinner on the beach at sunset.
examples.zh: 我們在日落時於海灘吃晚餐。

examples.en: Please come home before sunset.
examples.zh: 請在日落前回家。

examples.en: She is a strong supporter of the recycling program.
examples.zh: 她是回收計畫的堅定支持者。

examples.en: Thousands of supporters cheered for the home team.
examples.zh: 數千名球迷為主場球隊加油。

examples.en: The charity thanked every supporter for the help.
examples.zh: 這個慈善機構感謝每一位支持者的幫助。

examples.en: You will surely enjoy this movie.
examples.zh: 你一定會喜歡這部電影。

examples.en: Surely you remember our meeting last week.
examples.zh: 你想必記得我們上週的會面。

examples.en: The bus will surely arrive soon.
examples.zh: 公車很快就會到了。

examples.en: Mom put a white tablecloth on the dining table.
examples.zh: 媽媽在餐桌上鋪了一條白色桌布。

examples.en: I spilled juice on the tablecloth.
examples.zh: 我把果汁灑在桌布上了。

examples.en: This tablecloth has a pattern of small red flowers.
examples.zh: 這條桌布有紅色小花的圖案。

examples.en: She pinned the poster to the board with a tack.
examples.zh: 她用圖釘把海報釘在布告欄上。

examples.en: I stepped on a tack and hurt my foot.
examples.zh: 我踩到圖釘，腳受傷了。

examples.en: The company decided to try a different tack this year.
examples.zh: 公司今年決定嘗試不同的方針。

examples.en: Please tack the notice on the wall.
examples.zh: 請把通知用圖釘釘在牆上。

examples.en: The teacher tacked a map to the board.
examples.zh: 老師把地圖釘在黑板上。

examples.en: She tacked the hem before sewing it properly.
examples.zh: 她在正式縫好之前先把褲腳暫時縫住。

examples.en: The library has a reading room for teens.
examples.zh: 圖書館有一間青少年閱讀室。

examples.en: Many teens spend hours on their phones every evening.
examples.zh: 許多青少年每天晚上花好幾個小時在手機上。

examples.en: A group of teens volunteered at the animal shelter.
examples.zh: 一群青少年在動物收容所當志工。

examples.en: The store sells teen fashion at fair prices.
examples.zh: 這家店以合理的價格販售青少年服飾。

examples.en: She loves reading teen novels.
examples.zh: 她喜歡讀青少年小說。

examples.en: The program helps teen students learn career skills.
examples.zh: 這個計畫幫助青少年學生學習職場技能。

examples.en: The final game will be televised across the country.
examples.zh: 決賽將在全國電視轉播。

examples.en: The speech was televised live on Friday night.
examples.zh: 這場演講星期五晚上現場電視轉播。

examples.en: Not every school event is televised.
examples.zh: 並非每場學校活動都會電視轉播。

examples.en: Careful thinking will help you solve the problem.
examples.zh: 仔細思考會幫你解決這個問題。

examples.en: Her way of thinking is very creative.
examples.zh: 她的思維方式非常有創意。

examples.en: After some quick thinking, he found the answer.
examples.zh: 經過一番快速思考後，他找到了答案。

examples.en: A thunderstorm is coming, so we should go inside.
examples.zh: 雷雨要來了，我們應該進屋裡。

examples.en: The thunderstorm woke me up last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚的雷雨把我吵醒了。

examples.en: Flights were delayed because of the thunderstorm.
examples.zh: 班機因為雷雨而延誤。

examples.en: Please buy a tube of toothpaste at the supermarket.
examples.zh: 請在超市買一條牙膏。

examples.en: Put a small amount of toothpaste on your brush.
examples.zh: 在牙刷上擠一點牙膏。

examples.en: This toothpaste has a fresh mint flavor.
examples.zh: 這款牙膏有清新的薄荷味。

examples.en: New workers must finish a week of training.
examples.zh: 新進員工必須完成一週的培訓。

examples.en: The team's training starts at six every morning.
examples.zh: 球隊的訓練每天早上六點開始。

examples.en: She took a training course on first aid.
examples.zh: 她參加了一個急救訓練課程。

examples.en: Traveling by train is cheaper than flying.
examples.zh: 搭火車旅行比搭飛機便宜。

examples.en: She loves traveling to new countries with her family.
examples.zh: 她喜歡和家人到新的國家旅行。

examples.en: Traveling alone taught him to be independent.
examples.zh: 獨自旅行讓他學會獨立。

examples.en: A traveling circus came to our town.
examples.zh: 一個巡迴馬戲團來到我們鎮上。

examples.en: He packed a traveling bag for the trip.
examples.zh: 他為這趟旅行收拾了一個旅行袋。

examples.en: The traveling exhibition will visit five cities.
examples.zh: 這個巡迴展覽將到五座城市展出。

examples.en: Tulips bloom in the garden every spring.
examples.zh: 鬱金香每年春天都會在花園裡盛開。

examples.en: She gave her teacher a bunch of red tulips.
examples.zh: 她送給老師一束紅色鬱金香。

examples.en: The farm is famous for its colorful tulip fields.
examples.zh: 這座農場以色彩繽紛的鬱金香花田聞名。

examples.en: My grandfather still writes letters on an old typewriter.
examples.zh: 我爺爺仍然用一台舊打字機寫信。

examples.en: The museum has a typewriter from the 1950s.
examples.zh: 博物館有一台一九五〇年代的打字機。

examples.en: The typewriter made a loud sound with every key.
examples.zh: 每按一個鍵，打字機就發出很大的聲響。

examples.en: The office hired a fast typist to enter the data.
examples.zh: 辦公室僱了一位打字很快的打字員來輸入資料。

examples.en: She worked as a typist before becoming a manager.
examples.zh: 她在成為經理之前當過打字員。

examples.en: A good typist can type without looking at the keys.
examples.zh: 好的打字員不用看鍵盤就能打字。

examples.en: The mall has an underground parking lot.
examples.zh: 這間購物中心有地下停車場。

examples.en: Underground water supplies the whole village.
examples.zh: 地下水供應整個村莊。

examples.en: We walked through an underground passage to the station.
examples.zh: 我們穿過一條地下通道走到車站。

examples.en: In London, many people take the underground to work.
examples.zh: 在倫敦，許多人搭地鐵上班。

examples.en: The London underground was crowded during rush hour.
examples.zh: 倫敦地鐵在尖峰時段很擁擠。

examples.en: We got off the underground in Paris near the museum.
examples.zh: 我們在巴黎的博物館附近下了地鐵。

examples.en: The cables are buried underground.
examples.zh: 電纜埋在地下。

examples.en: Moles live underground and dig long tunnels.
examples.zh: 鼴鼠住在地下並挖很長的隧道。

examples.en: The workers went underground to fix the pipes.
examples.zh: 工人們到地下去修理水管。

examples.en: She has a good understanding of basic math.
examples.zh: 她對基礎數學有很好的理解。

examples.en: Thank you for your patience and understanding.
examples.zh: 謝謝您的耐心與體諒。

examples.en: The two teams reached an understanding about the schedule.
examples.zh: 兩支隊伍就時程達成了共識。

examples.en: My teacher was understanding when I handed in my homework late.
examples.zh: 我晚交作業時，老師很體諒。

examples.en: He is an understanding friend who always listens.
examples.zh: 他是個善解人意的朋友，總是願意傾聽。

examples.en: Our boss was very understanding about the family emergency.
examples.zh: 老闆對那次家庭緊急狀況非常體諒。

examples.en: The diver took underwater photos of the coral.
examples.zh: 潛水員拍了珊瑚的水中照片。

examples.en: We visited an underwater museum on our trip.
examples.zh: 我們旅行時參觀了一座水下博物館。

examples.en: The underwater world is full of colorful fish.
examples.zh: 水中世界充滿了色彩繽紛的魚。

examples.en: He can swim underwater for almost a minute.
examples.zh: 他可以在水中游將近一分鐘。

examples.en: Turtles stay underwater for a long time.
examples.zh: 烏龜可以在水下待很久。

examples.en: The camera still works underwater.
examples.zh: 這台相機在水下仍然可以使用。

senses.zh: 體重過輕的；重量不足的

examples.en: The doctor said the baby was slightly underweight.
examples.zh: 醫生說這個嬰兒體重稍微過輕。

examples.en: Being underweight can affect your health.
examples.zh: 體重過輕可能影響健康。

examples.en: Some of the boxes were found to be underweight.
examples.zh: 有些箱子被發現重量不足。

examples.en: We received an unexpected visit from our uncle.
examples.zh: 我們意外地迎來了叔叔的來訪。

examples.en: The test results were unexpected.
examples.zh: 測驗結果出乎意料。

examples.en: An unexpected storm forced us to cancel the picnic.
examples.zh: 一場突如其來的暴風雨迫使我們取消野餐。

examples.en: The cause of the fire is still unknown.
examples.zh: 起火原因仍然不明。

examples.en: An unknown number called me three times last night.
examples.zh: 有個不知名的號碼昨晚打給我三次。

examples.en: She felt nervous about traveling to an unknown city.
examples.zh: 她對前往陌生的城市感到緊張。

examples.en: Unlike his brother, he enjoys quiet evenings at home.
examples.zh: 和他哥哥不同，他喜歡在家度過安靜的夜晚。

examples.en: Unlike last year, this summer is very rainy.
examples.zh: 和去年不同，今年夏天雨很多。

examples.en: The new phone is unlike any I have used before.
examples.zh: 這支新手機和我以前用過的都不一樣。

examples.en: The two sisters are quite unlike in personality.
examples.zh: 這兩姊妹的個性截然不同。

examples.en: The results of the two tests were very unlike.
examples.zh: 兩次測驗的結果非常不同。

examples.en: The twins looked unlike each other despite being the same age.
examples.zh: 雙胞胎雖然同年，卻長得不像。

senses.zh: 未動過的；未受影響的；原封不動的

examples.en: The food on his plate was untouched.
examples.zh: 他盤子裡的食物原封不動。

examples.en: The island remains untouched by tourism.
examples.zh: 這座島沒有受到觀光的影響。

examples.en: She left the letter untouched on the desk.
examples.zh: 她把信原封不動地留在書桌上。

senses.zh: 不尋常的；罕見的；獨特的

examples.en: It is unusual for him to be late for school.
examples.zh: 他上學遲到是很不尋常的。

examples.en: She has an unusual hobby of collecting old keys.
examples.zh: 她有收集舊鑰匙這個獨特的嗜好。

examples.en: We saw an unusual bird near the lake.
examples.zh: 我們在湖邊看到一隻罕見的鳥。
